name: seva-jump
description: Seva Jump Android wrapper and web build tools.

scripts.test: node tests/rule-checks.js && node tests/full-run-checks.js && node tests/endless-bird-checks.js && node tests/hard-mode-checks.js && node tests/power-jump-checks.js && node tests/soak-test.js
scripts.test:runtime: node tests/runtime-browser-checks.js && node tests/gameplay-runtime-checks.js && node tests/service-worker-checks.js
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:sync && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
